items.title: feat(database): hold Gateway state ownership in PostgreSQL on all-Pos…
items.summary: feat(database): hold Gateway state ownership in PostgreSQL on all-PostgreSQL installs (#196237) * feat(database): hold Gateway ownership in PostgreSQL for localStores none - Add database.localStores ("anchors" default, "none"); config validation accepts "none" only when database.engine is postgres and no family overrides to sqlite. In this stage "none" only moves Gateway ownership. - With "none", engine selection carries an installation UUID read from or created once in /postgres-install.json (0600, link() publish). - acquireGatewayLock also takes a session-level pg_try_advisory_lock keyed by the installation UUID on one dedicated connection outside the pool (TCP keepalive, 10 s query timeout), and writes _install.gateway_owner (pid, host, boot id, heartbeat). - Contention reuses GatewayStateOwnerContentionError, names the install schema and the holder's pid, host and boot id, and is logged once per holder while a Gateway waits. - Session end, a failed heartbeat or a query timeout marks ownership lost and closes the session, releasing the lock; later ownership checks fail. - Default mode and mixed installs take no PostgreSQL lock and create no install schema. - Docs: "Gateway ownership in PostgreSQL" in database-engines.md, including the session-mode pooler requirement; regenerated config baseline hashes. - Test-lines allocation for the new PostgreSQL and config coverage. Part of #196156 * fix(database): type the owner heartbeat catch as unknown - Heartbeat failure callback takes `unknown` (use-unknown-in-catch-callback-variable) and keeps the original error as the cause. - Tests go through acquireConfiguredGatewayPostgresOwner, so the test-only exports acquireGatewayPostgresOwner and gatewayOwnerLockKey are no longer exported (production unused-export scan). - Test-lines allocation updated to the exact net growth (+181). Part of #196156 * fix(database): retire the Gateway when PostgreSQL ownership is lost - PostgreSQL session loss aborts a custody signal that retires the process state owner, so admission, queued work and the server lifecycle all stop. - Bound connection startup with connectionTimeoutMillis and every session close with the same 10 s; release never rejects, so local custody is always released. - Stop the heartbeat after loss; a silent network is reported by the next heartbeat within about 20 s. - Drop postgres-install.json and the install schema; the lock key is the schema prefix within the database, and the holder is read from pg_locks and pg_stat_activity. * fix(database): take PostgreSQL custody for cold CLI owners - A cold CLI owner resolves its configured engine after taking the lock, so the lock saw no PostgreSQL selection and skipped installation custody. - The lock handle now takes PostgreSQL custody once the selection is in scope; runWithLocalStateOwner calls it before stateful work. Config-only repair keeps its offline boundary. - Custody loss still retires the same process owner; a sibling helper keeps gateway-lock.ts under its line cap. * fix(database): keep PostgreSQL custody while retained leases hold the owner - Uncertain child cleanup borrows the process owner before the lock is released; release used to end the PostgreSQL session anyway, so another host could take ownership while child work still ran. - acquireGatewayStateOwner takes an onReleased hook that runs once physical custody ends, after the last retained lease; the lock ends its PostgreSQL session there. * Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into feat/postgres-install-registry * refactor(database): name the setting database.postgres.ownership - database.localStores "none" becomes database.postgres.ownership "installation"; the default is "state-directory". - The name now describes what this release changes (Gateway state ownership) instead of an end state where anchors are gone. - Validation, runtime selection, tests and the operator guide follow the new key. * Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into feat/postgres-install-registry * Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into feat/postgres-install-registry * fix(database): bound PostgreSQL ownership handoff * fix: refresh the reviewed correction baseline Baseline-Refresh: a62260acc6a7472995dadd2dd749b8ba579784cb * test(database): cover capture and ownership config integration * fix(database): type bounded owner queries and regression fixtures Co-authored-by: Mitchell Etzel Co-authored-by: Mitchell Etzel Co-authored-by: Vincent Koc

items.title: fix(mattermost): answer shows twice when a post lands below the strea…
items.summary: fix(mattermost): answer shows twice when a post lands below the streaming preview (#198206) fix(mattermost): keep answer text out of a preview that is no longer last With the default preview streaming, when another post landed below the preview during a run (for example a message-tool progress note), the answer was streamed into the old preview and then posted again as a new post, with the preview deleted afterwards. Clients that keep deleted posts, such as the Mattermost iOS app, showed the answer twice. Answer text now goes into the preview only while it is still the newest post; otherwise the preview keeps its status text and the answer is posted once below. If the order check fails, it falls back silently to streaming in place. Runs with no newer post, thread replies and block streaming are otherwise unchanged. No new text. Evidence: a built Gateway with the bundled Mattermost plugin against a real Mattermost server in Docker, with a stand-in model that sends a message-tool progress note and then streams the answer, main twice and candidate twice. On main the answer was edited into the preview three times and then posted again, so two posts held the answer. With this change the preview kept only its status text and exactly one answer post appeared. A run with no newer post still streams in place, a thread reply shows the same fix, and block streaming behaves the same on both. All five placement cases in the existing test fail on main, at net 0 test lines. Details: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/198206#issuecomment-6851590438. Closes #198205. Thanks @hannnnn-l. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: 美而快電商系統遭異常存取，部分請求涉及會員訂單API
items.summary: 11月12日電子商務及服飾零售公司美而快（5321）於股市公開資訊觀測站發布重大訊息，該公司於11月10日接獲客戶反映，有消費者收到疑似詐騙電子郵件，他們隨即啟動資安應變及調查機制，經回溯分析系統存取紀錄，發現外部特定IP位址曾對電商系統進行異常存取，部分請求涉及會員訂單相關API。

items.title: 長榮物流部分資訊系統遭攻擊，啟動資安防禦與復原機制
items.summary: 11月12日物流及貨運服務公司榮運（2607）於股市公開資訊觀測站發布重大訊息，長榮物流部分資訊系統遭受駭客攻擊，伺服器出現異常情形，公司隨即啟動資安應變措施因應，目前資訊系統已恢復正常，初步評估對公司財務及業務並無重大影響。

items.title: 泰航與芬蘭航空各因Amadeus資安事件外洩逾6萬筆與11萬筆旅客資訊
items.summary: 泰國航空（Thai Airways）及芬蘭航空（Finnair）週一（11月9日）公告， 訂票服務系統供應商Amadeus遭到非法存取，分別導致超過6萬及11.6萬筆乘客記錄可能外流。
